title: LifeLine
tagline: Real-time ambulance dispatch and hospital coordination platform.
shortDescription: A real-time ambulance dispatch and operations platform connecting dispatchers, drivers, and hospitals with live tracking, incident management, and RBAC.
description: LifeLine is a real-time Android ambulance dispatch and operations platform built with Flutter and Firebase. It coordinates dispatchers, emergency drivers, and hospitals through live fleet maps, automated incident logging, and role-based access control.

caseStudy.problem: Emergency medical dispatch often suffers from communication delays, lack of live fleet visibility, and disconnected hospital coordination during critical transit windows.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered a layered Flutter & Firebase architecture providing dedicated Dispatcher, Driver, and Admin portals synchronized in real time via Cloud Firestore and Google Maps.
features: Dispatcher dashboard with live fleet map & real-time ambulance status
Incident creation, priority tracking & emergency timeline history
Driver dashboard with real-time turn-by-turn hospital routing & status toggles
Admin portal for RBAC, hospital management, ambulance fleet & user accounts
Cloud Firestore realtime synchronization for fleet telemetry and incident state
Google Maps & Google Places integration for location-based hospital selection
caseStudy.challenges: Managing multi-role state transitions, live geolocation streaming, and offline-tolerant Firebase synchronization across drivers and dispatchers.
caseStudy.outcome: Released production-ready APK (LifeLine-v1.0.0.apk) with complete role-based workflows and verified real-time dispatch capabilities.
caseStudy.learnings: Flutter layered architecture (UI → Controllers → Repositories), Firestore real-time listener patterns, and Google Maps SDK integration for Android.
